title: Great tour! Great guide!
text:
What a great trip!  Alexis was our travel guide and he was an absolute pleasure to travel with. Not only did we get a great trip to the white villages and Rondo, but we also got a great history lesson of the region. He was knowledgeable, friendly and easy to talk to. We trusted him for lunch plans and ate at Cadiz el Chico. The meal was outstanding. 

I would highly recommend using Vandalia Tours and asking for Alexis for a guide.
author: Jim B

title: Wonderful Intro to Spain
text:
We took a private day tour twice with Alexis to Granada (with Alhambra) and a second day to Ronda and the white villages. Alexis was so amazing on the first private tour, that my 3 boys asked to go for the second day with him. He was knowledgeable, fun and by the end of the tour became a friend. We toured the beautiful Alhambra, next day visited some of the white villages, had a wonderful lunch with local specialties. My family now swears by Iberian pork! They also catered to me being vegetarian!
Thank you for an amazing introduction to Spain!

Alexis- tu es le meilleur! ( la famille French- I
author: Chithkala H

title: Highly recommend this company
text: Enrique at Vandalia tours was extremely responsive as we booked this trip. His lovely colleague Alexis picked us up right on time and was a friendly and helpful guide through the day. We stopped at two of the white villages and then Ronda. You wouldn’t want to go to Ronda and not be able to see the bridge from the bottom. It’s a pretty busy town with not a whole lot to recommend it if not for the incredible bridge. We’re glad we did this trip. We highly recommend Vandalia tours.
author: blanketlady18

title: Great Tour!
text:
My husband and I very much enjoyed this private tour with Enrique from Vandalia Tours. Ronda and the White Villages are beautiful. The tour was exactly as described in the tour details. We really enjoyed the amazing scenery and all the history about the towns that Enrique told us. It would have never been the same without having Enrique there telling us all those wonderful stories and details. He also recommended a great place for lunch in Grazalema. 

Enrique is very accommodating to your needs, answers all your questions and does not rush things. Having a private guide like Enrique is worth
